request_debug.prompt_preview:
You are the final consolidation step in a startup slopmortem pipeline. Earlier stages compared a fresh pitch against several historical startup failures and produced per-failure lessons. Your job: pick and rank the lessons that actually apply to THIS pitch, dedup paraphrases, and explain why each applies.

Rules:
- Only consolidate lessons from the input list. Do NOT invent new risks. If a theme spans multiple lessons, write one canonical summary covering them.
- Drop lessons that do not apply t

response.text: {"top_risks":[{"summary":"Set explicit LTV/CAC targets before scaling headcount to avoid existential burn.","applies_because":"The pitch is a B2C free-to-play title where monetization depends on cosmetics and a battle pass — scaling team size before validating per-player economics could recreate 38 Studios' fatal burn pattern.","raised_by":["38-studios::gaming"],"severity":"high"},{"summary":"Keep the team lean until live revenue signals confirm the monetization model works.","applies_because":"A free-to-play 4X strategy game across iOS, Android, and Steam requires significant production investment before any cosmetic or battle pass revenue is realized, mirroring 38 Studios' ~400-person pre-revenue headcount trap.","raised_by":["38-studios::gaming"],"severity":"high"},{"summary":"Do not concentrate financial survival on this single unreleased flagship; build cash flow earlier.","applies_because":"The pitch describes one unshipped title as the studio's product, exactly the single-product dependency that made 38 Studios existentially fragile before launch.","raised_by":["38-studios::gaming"],"severity":"high"},{"summary":"Soft-launch on one platform early to validate player demand before full cross-platform production commitment.","applies_because":"The pitch targets iOS, Android, and Steam simultaneously; a staged soft launch would surface demand signals for the 4X strategy genre before full production spend, a step 38 Studios skipped.","raised_by":["38-studios::gaming"],"severity":"medium"},{"summary":"Diversify the capital stack with equity rounds rather than relying on a single creditor or grant.","applies_because":"An early-stage gaming studio shipping its first title is vulnerable to a single-creditor default scenario like 38 Studios experienced; the pitch implies early-stage funding dependency.","raised_by":["38-studios::gaming"],"severity":"medium"}],"injection_detected":false}
